hook.voiceover: Four things that blew up overnight.

stories.headline: GTA 6 is finally out
stories.voiceover: GTA 6 is finally out. It's unlocking at midnight, country by country.
stories.concept: clock races to 00:00, giant padlock explodes into shards, Rockstar logo punches through, world map lights up zone by zone
stories.source: Rockstar Games newswire, CBS News, NBC Chicago

photo.credit: Photo: Take-Two Interativa de / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons

stories.headline: Apple's own update broke Apple
stories.voiceover: Apple says its own update broke iCloud, Apple Pay and the App Store. Not a hack.
stories.concept: update bar hits 100%, iPhone app icons crack and topple like dominoes, red OUTAGE glitch, NOT A HACK stamp

photo.credit: Photo: Original: Rob Janoff / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons

stories.headline: OpenAI's new AI hit 'High'
stories.voiceover: OpenAI says its newest model is the first it rates high for helping AI improve itself.
stories.concept: AI chip builds a copy of itself, risk meter needle slams from LOW into HIGH, alarm light

photo.credit: Photo: OpenAI / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons

stories.headline: A giant star ate a smaller one
stories.voiceover: And in Andromeda, a giant star swallowed a smaller one. It took about seven years.
stories.concept: small star spirals into a huge red supergiant, gets swallowed, blinding flash, dust shell explodes outward, 7 YEARS slams

photo.credit: Photo: NASA/JPL/California Institute of Technology / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons
